label: D1 after an a1 choice that hit a rare transition (a1 -> S2)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Almost all activations (prev_common==1 has 32 of 20825; prev_action==2 has 32) follow a previous trial in which the agent chose a1 and went rare to S2. The remaining ~13% of mass is at the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window, so these are most likely the same condition and simply unobservable here. Recall 0.85 and mass recall 0.87, but precision is only ~0.46: about half of a1->S2 rare D1 steps stay silent. Magnitude is larger after a rewarded rare trial (with prev_reward==1 precision is 0.63 and mass recall exceeds recall), and firing also drifts with episode position: almost none in trials 0-9 or 90-99, and the most in trials 40-79. Restricting to trials 10-89 brings F1 to 0.65. Conditioning on the hidden good state or the policy logit does not help. Does not fire after common transitions or after a2 choices. Only observed variables are used.
